unresolved: Vessel-form genealogy conflict: the chain pan-kou-hu -> tianji-hu -> long-er-hu has a prototype and intermediate links and is decidable; the chain yuhuchun-ping -> suantouping/fengweiping rests on one sentence in Xia Yanjing 2016, while Tian Zibing records bronze and pottery suantouping already in the Qin dynasty ('bulbous near the mouth, usually six-lobed'), so the Yuan porcelain form cannot be a derivative of yuhuchun; the two accounts cannot both hold and are kept side by side

Name-form displacement: three mechanisms coexist - name follows form (after the Yuan, vessels with a spout are called hu and those without are called ping, per Gegu Yaolun); form persists while the name migrates (suantouping spans Qin bronze/pottery and Yuan porcelain; duozi-he has three referents of which only the second is porcelain); one form carries several names (tianji-hu = jitou-hu = jishou-hu; zhi-hu = zhu-zi; jiguang-hu = pinang-hu = deng-hu = madeng-hu = mameng)

Jiguang-hu classification: Gao Feng divides by presence of a handle loop into youkong-shi and tiliang-shi, Tian Zibing divides by body (flat/round/low), handle form (huan-liang/heng-liang) and number of holes into five types; the two schemes do not map onto each other. Xia Yanjing's plates show gold and silver jiguang-hu, while Gao Feng, Tian Zibing and Zhao Nong describe porcelain ones; the relation between the materials is not discussed in any of the five books

Liao porcelain: only two大类 are enumerated (Zhongyuan-style and Qidan-style), with no periodization, no kiln list, and no functional explanation of Qidan forms; the uses given for jitui-tan ('suitable for storing wine and easy to ferment' vs 'takes little space in a tent and is easy to hold') are both conjectures

Vessel dimensions are almost entirely absent: only meiping (height c. 40 cm, mouth 4-5 cm) and zhuo-qi (1,340 sets of 27 pieces each; Longqing increases of 36 and 61 pieces) carry absolute figures; the zhuo-qi list totals 29 items against a stated 27 per set, unexplained by the source

Form vocabulary has no shared scale: the relations among chikou, changkou, liankou and penkou are not given; the 'pan-kou' of pan-kou-hu, the 'kuo-yan' of zhadou and the 'zhi-kou' of jiaer-guan cannot be converted into one descriptive scale

Daoliu-hu is described only by principle (no neck, round body, filled from a small opening in the base, inner wall divided into a circulating channel); no section drawing or inner-tube structure is given
Shengyou-deng: the two-layer oil/water construction and the cooling rationale come from a Lu You quotation and a Joseph Needham appraisal; no vessel dimensions, no experimental data
Zhuo-qi: the source lists 1,340 sets, 27 pieces per set, and Longqing increases of 36 and 61 pieces; whether the increase is per set or total is not stated
notes: 本批新建 1 个 Topic（B.6.5 器形、器类与成套组合），挂载 22 个 KU，不新增 Theme。结构设计的三项判断：其一，Topic 名与原定方案不同——h24 manifest 登记的是「B.6.5 瓷器器形与器类」，读完 22 条候选（术语 20、器物 2）后，材料实际按「形从哪里来」分成取象（7）、追加（5）、用法定形（4）、组合成类（2）四条路径，另有两个横切层（描述语汇 1、族群标识 1），故改题「器形、器类与成套组合：瓷器形态的四种生成路径」；四条路径是并存的发生机制而非四个阶段，且常叠加于同一器物（鸡冠壶＝取象＋追加，元代壶＝追加＋称名重写）。其二，本 Topic 不画器形树：两条谱系链方向冲突，盘口壶→天鸡壶→龙耳壶可判定，玉壶春→蒜头瓶／凤尾瓶与田自秉所记秦代已有蒜头瓶冲突、不可判定；器名与器形按名随形改、形存名移、名多形一三种方式脱节，以器名建类会把不同生成路径的器物排进同一序列。其三，证据分三档：有尺度与套数（梅瓶、桌器）、有形制描述无尺度（多数条目）、只有图注一行（两件代表器物），器形比较只能停在形制描述层。三项边界处置：蒜头瓶与多子盒以 boundary_case 挂载，只为登记同名跨材质；魂瓶、茧形壶与陶器器形留 B.5；装饰与纹样归 B.6.4 与 C，窑口归 B.6.3，胎料与装烧归 B.6.2。本批不 commit、不 push。
